text:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync for tomorrow's ISV toolchain demo with LangChain folks. Need to run through ops + comms checklist here.
jonathan (PM): Agenda: 1) verify demo auth + SSO, 2) confirm model routing (primary/dedicated -> fallback hosted), 3) go/no-go checklist for joint announcement.
lee (Eng): Ops notes: primary will be dedicated us-west2 cluster (reserved), fallback to hosted quantized instance in us-east1. I'll pre-warm KV cache and pin model v1.3.2 to the canary slot.
nashley (Marketing): Partner asked for co-branded slide and a short one-paragraph quote. Legal already sent redlines yesterday?
sam (Partner Eng): Legal redlines accepted; partner provided logo SVG. I uploaded the SVG to the partner assets page and DM'd the link. Also verified SAML metadata with test user `demo+langchain@acme.com`.
maria (Partnerships): Great. Ops action items: @lee do autoscale bump and smoke test; @sam confirm SSO on staging; @jonathan run a dry-run with partner at 9:30am PT; @ashley draft assets + embargo timing.
lee (Eng): Autoscale: raising max replicas by +2 for 10:45-11:05 PT window. Smoke test schedule 10:15 PT. I'll run health + warm commands:```bash
# health check
curl -sSf https://us-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/health || echo 'health fail'
# warm cache and run a small burst
curl -X POST https://us-west2.api.redwood.ai/v1/batch/warm -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompts": ["hello demo"], "count": 3}'
```
lee (Eng): I'll also run a synthetic token burst (2000 tokens over 30s) at 10:20 PT to validate autoscale brings up extra workers.
deploy-bot: Deploy to demo cluster finished: redwood/demo:2026-03-21-rc7. No active alerts.
jonathan (PM): Demo script note: start with a cold-run to show latency improvements after cache warm; then switch to a routed multi-model example. Partner will run a tool call to a simple retrieval gateway.
sam (Partner Eng): Retrieval gateway endpoint: https://gateway.partner.io/api/retrieve (we'll proxy). Confirm we allow outbound calls from demo cluster.
lee (Eng): Outbound allowed. I'll add a temporary egress rule and remove after demo. Also adding a healthcheck for the gateway proxy:```http
GET /api/probe HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.partner.io
```
ashley (Marketing): Proposed embargo: publish at 2:00pm PT Thurs. We need assets + partner signoff by 10:00am Thu. Can legal confirm co-announcement copy ASAP?
maria (Partnerships): Partner legal already okayed the copy last night per @sam. We still need an internal review from comms.
jonathan (PM): Risk register: 1) cert rotation for partner SAML, 2) quota bump failure on dedicated pool, 3) retrieval gateway latency >500ms. Mitigations: automated cert reload, fallback to hosted small model, and prefetching docs into local temp store.
sam (Partner Eng): For cert rotation, partner rotates monthly but publishes new certs to the portal. I built a script that pulls latest cert and posts to our SSO endpoint. Will run it during smoke test.
lee (Eng): I'll add `/opt/redwood/sso/reload.sh` to crontab for a one-time reload during prep. Script snippet:```bash
scp partner@portal:/certs/langchain.pem /opt/redwood/sso/langchain.pem && systemctl restart redwood-sso || echo 'sso reload fail'
```
lee (Eng): After smoke test I'll paste the logs: expected output `200 OK /health`, `cache warmed: keys=5`, `burst: autoscale added 2 nodes`.
jonathan (PM): Greenroom: create `#greenroom-demo-langchain` for the live run and invite partner PM + SE. We'll be in there 15m prior.
ashley (Marketing): I'll prepare a single slide failover diagram showing primary -> fallback -> contact points. Dropping draft in thread by EOD.
sam (Partner Eng): Small privacy reminder: demo prompts must be sanitized. I sent partner a cleaning script and a sample redaction policy.
maria (Partnerships): TL;DR: smoke test 10:15 PT, synthetic burst 10:20, dry-run with partner 9:30am, autoscale bump during demo window, assets + embargo confirmed. Ping me if anything pops. :thumbsup:
lee (Eng): Copy. Posting smoke test results shortly after 10:15.
deploy-bot: Canary roll complete. Monitoring: all service checks PASS.
